why_no_choice_is_made: The ORION-22 second-family transfer requires ONE family (E3 Defects4J or E2 OpenML) to be chosen BEFORE protocol freeze. Choosing it is a protocol act, not an acquisition act, and making that choice here after having looked at both would destroy the pre-freeze property the design depends on. Both are therefore recorded as available, neither is selected, and the choice is left to whoever writes the freeze.
